hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git push[^|;&]*\bmain\b'; then LAST=$(git -C /Users/bashtan/Projects/bakalo-site log -1 --format='%s' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$LAST" | grep -qE '^feat[:(]'; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Staging-first rule: push to a fix/<name> branch — CI creates a preview URL at fix-<name>.bakalo-capital.pages.dev. Merge to main only after stakeholder sign-off."}'; fi; fi

HANDOFF=$(git -C /Users/bashtan/Projects/bakalo-site log -1 --format='%H' -- HANDOFF.md 2>/dev/null); HEAD=$(git -C /Users/bashtan/Projects/bakalo-site rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$HEAD" ] && [ "$HANDOFF" != "$HEAD" ]; then echo "HANDOFF.md is behind HEAD. Update it to reflect recent work, then commit it."; exit 2; fi
